name: Vision (Deathless)

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Phase Shift
While an Opponent is suffering from Heal Block, Deathless Vision gains +[888.88 - 2,554.86] Attack Rating.
For every 4% of the Opponent's Max Health prevented by Heal Block, inflict an instant Degeneration dealing a burst of [1,532.55 - 3,575.96] Direct Damage.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Ani Soğuk Bağışıklığı 🧊
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Thanos (Deathless)) 🧠

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: The process of becoming Deathless has altered Vision, encrypting his complex robotics in darkness, providing full Immunity to Poison, Bleed, Coldsnap and Frostbite effects.

abilitySections.title: Phasing
content: If Deathless Vision's Special Attacks reduce the Opponent's Power below any full Bar, gain 1 Phase Charge. Max stacks: 5.

When Deathless Vision would perform a Well-Timed Block, convert 1 Phase Charge into a Phase Passive for 2 seconds, causing incoming attacks to have a 100% chance to Miss. Phase Charges cannot be converted while already Phasing.
While Phased, Deathless Vision is Immune to incoming Stun effects.
While Phased, hits grant a +[1,328.21] Fury Passive for 22 seconds. Max stacks: 10.
When an attack Misses Deathless Vision, pause all Fury effects for 8 seconds.
If activated during an Opponent's Special Attack, gain an additional Fury Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Special Attack hits grant no Power to the Opponent.
If a Special Attack or effect generates a Phase Charge, inflict a Heal Block Passive for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Burns up to 40% of a Bar of Power, dealing Direct Damage proportionate to the amount lost.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Burns up to 135% of a Bar of Power, dealing Direct Damage proportionate to the amount lost.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Burns up to 200% of a Bar of Power, dealing Direct Damage proportionate to the amount lost.
